generic.title: $t(product) could not continue
generic.tip: Close the pane and open the message again. If it keeps happening, quote the code below to your IT team.

tips.network: Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, quote the code below to your IT team.
tips.auth: $t(product) could not sign you in. Try again, and if you are asked to sign in, complete the prompt.
tips.permission: Your account is not allowed to use $t(product). Ask your IT team to give you access, and quote the code below.
tips.deployment: This is a problem with the $t(product) installation rather than with you. Quote the code below to your IT team.

unsupported.title: $t(product) cannot run here
unsupported.generic: $t(product) could not start in this window. Try opening the message in Outlook again.
unsupported.timeout: $t(product) could not reach Outlook. Check your connection, then open the message again.
unsupported.host: $t(product) reports email, so it only runs in Outlook.
unsupported.disabled: $t(product) is switched off for your organisation. Your IT team can turn it back on.
unsupported.requirement-set: This version of Outlook is too old for $t(product). Update Outlook, or open the message in Outlook on the web.

report.title: Report this mail
report.description: Tell us what is wrong with the message you have open.

empty.title: No message open
empty.description: Open a message in Outlook to report it.

suspicious.title: Suspicious
suspicious.description: Something about this message looks off.

comment.label: Anything else we should know?
comment.placeholder: Anything that would help someone reading this later

confirmation.title: Sent to $t(product)
confirmation.body: $t(product) is processing the message. You can close this pane.

suspicious.title: Thanks for reporting
suspicious.body: The mail is on its way to the security team.

spam.title: Reported as spam
spam.body: Mail like it should stop reaching your inbox.

identified.system: $t(product) already knows this mail. The security team is on it.
identified.simulation: This was a phishing test from your own organisation. Reporting it was the right thing to do.
identified.unknown: $t(product) has not seen this mail before, so someone will take a look.

notified.title: Who was told
notified.failed: Could not reach {{address}} — the report was still filed

disposition.move-failed: The mail could not be moved. Your report was filed — you can move the mail yourself.
